mapper.select: SELECT * FROM conversations WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM conversations WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND client_request_id=#{clientRequestId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM conversations WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM conversations WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO conversations (id,user_id,client_request_id,title,status,version,created_at,updated_at,deleted_at) VALUES (#{id},#{userId},#{clientRequestId},#{title},#{status},#{version},#{createdAt},#{updatedAt},#{deletedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.update: UPDATE conversations SET title=#{title}, status=#{status}, version=#{version}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE conversations SET status='deleted', deleted_at=#{deletedAt}, updated_at=#{deletedAt}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE conversation_messages SET deleted_at=#{deletedAt} WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM conversation_messages WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND client_message_id=#{clientMessageId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM conversation_messages WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM conversation_messages WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND reply_to_message_id=#{messageId} AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM conversation_messages WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND role='user' AND status='processing' AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM conversation_messages WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId}
SELECT * FROM conversation_messages WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT * FROM conversation_messages WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND (created_at < #{before} OR (created_at = #{before} AND id < #{beforeId})) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM conversation_messages WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at < #{before} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE conversation_messages SET status=#{status} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='processing' AND generation_attempt=#{attempt} AND deleted_at IS NULL

UPDATE conversation_messages SET status='processing', generation_attempt=generation_attempt+1, generation_started_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} AND status='failed' AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE conversation_messages SET status='failed' WHERE role='user' AND status='processing' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(generation_started_at, created_at) < #{before}
